records.title: 10-K
records.text: In 2021, we generated $663.6 million in total revenue, with a revenue mix of: cloud subscriptions 18%; software license 6%; maintenance 22%; services revenue 50%; and hardware 4%.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: By comparison, in 2016, cloud subscriptions and software license revenue represented 7% and 93%, respectively, of our total cloud and software license revenue mix.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our international revenue was approximately $196.4 million, $178.1 million and $189.1 million for the years ended December 31, 2021, 2020 and 2019, respectively, which represents approximately 30%, 30% and 31% of our total revenue for the years ended December 31, 2021, 2020 and 2019, respectively.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our R&D expenses for the years ended December 31, 2021, 2020 and 2019 were $97.6 million, $84.3 million, and $87.6 million, respectively.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: For 2021, we generated cash flow from operating activities of $185.2 million and have generated a cumulative total of $473.0 million for the three years ended December 31, 2021.
